import pandas as pd, numpy as np
D=pd.read_csv('data.csv'); D['date']=pd.to_datetime(D['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
print('Date range',D.date.min(),D.date.max(),'days',D.date.nunique(),'accounts',D.account_id.nunique())
print('Account row counts:\n',D.account_id.value_counts().to_string())
A=D[D.account_id.eq('xz8lX1K')].copy()
print('\nTarget rows:',len(A),'dates:',sorted(A.date.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d').unique()))
print('\nDaily totals target:')
print(A.groupby('date').unblended_cost.agg(['sum','count']).to_string())
print('\nUnique target resources:')
for c in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family','commitment_start','commitment_end']:
 print(c,A[c].nunique(), sorted(A[c].astype(str).unique())[:40])
print('\nCosts formula check max error:',(D.price*D.num_instances*24-D.unblended_cost).abs().max())
print('\nTarget date rows:')
print(A[A.date.eq('2025-10-20')].sort_values('unblended_cost',ascending=False).to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
D=pd.read_csv('data.csv'); D.date=pd.to_datetime(D.date,format='%m/%d/%y')
keys=['instance_family','csp','cloud_service','application']
p=D.pivot_table(index=keys,columns='date',values='unblended_cost',aggfunc='sum')
# only predate
pre=D[D.date<'2025-10-20'].pivot_table(index=keys,columns='date',values='unblended_cost',aggfunc='sum')
cur=D[D.date=='2025-10-20'].set_index(keys).unblended_cost
r=pd.DataFrame({'cur':cur,'prev':pre['2025-10-19'],'pre_mean':pre.mean(axis=1),'pre_median':pre.median(axis=1),'pre_min':pre.min(axis=1),'pre_max':pre.max(axis=1)})
r['delta_prev']=r.cur-r.prev;r['delta_mean']=r.cur-r.pre_mean
r['after']=D[D.date>'2025-10-20'].pivot_table(index=keys,columns='date',values='unblended_cost',aggfunc='sum').mean(axis=1)
print('Top deltas previous day:')
print(r.sort_values('delta_prev',ascending=False).head(20).round(2).to_string())
print('\nTop deltas baseline mean:')
print(r.sort_values('delta_mean',ascending=False).head(20).round(2).to_string())
print('\nTop absolute deltas previous:')
print(r.reindex(r.delta_prev.abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index).head(20).round(2).to_string())
print('\nTotal delta prev',r.delta_prev.sum(),'mean',r.delta_mean.sum())
# Details for strongest suspects
sus=list(r.sort_values('delta_prev',ascending=False).head(8).index)
print('\nDaily details suspects:')
for k in sus:
 x=D
 for c,v in zip(keys,k):x=x[x[c]==v]
 print('\n',k)
 print(x[['date','price','num_instances','unblended_cost','commitment_start','commitment_end']].to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
D=pd.read_csv('data.csv'); D.date=pd.to_datetime(D.date,format='%m/%d/%y')
for resource in ['QI78eHTqNo','W4ugKNiEYE','dEUiFDB4IN']:
 x=D[D.instance_family.eq(resource)].sort_values('date')
 print('\nRESOURCE',resource, 'identity:',x[['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']].drop_duplicates().to_dict('records'))
 print(x[['date','price','num_instances','unblended_cost','commitment_start','commitment_end']].to_string(index=False))
print('\nCommitment groups daily totals:')
print(D.groupby(['date','commitment_start','commitment_end']).unblended_cost.sum().unstack().round(2).to_string())
print('\nCount of resources by commitments:')
print(D.groupby(['commitment_start','commitment_end']).instance_family.nunique())
print('\nResources starting commitment on anomaly date:')
print(D[(D.commitment_start=='10/20/25') & (D.date=='2025-10-20')].to_string(index=False))
print('\nQI and W4 cost on date vs all others:')
cur=D[D.date=='2025-10-20'].copy();cur['suspect']=cur.instance_family.isin(['QI78eHTqNo','W4ugKNiEYE'])
print(cur.groupby('suspect').unblended_cost.sum())

import pandas as pd
D=pd.read_csv('data.csv'); D.date=pd.to_datetime(D.date,format='%m/%d/%y')
print(D[D.instance_family=='dEUiFDB4IN'].sort_values('date')[['date','price','num_instances','unblended_cost','commitment_start','commitment_end']].to_string(index=False))
# concise decomposition of all per-resource changes on 20 vs 19, and recurring anomaly patterns
P=D.pivot(index='instance_family',columns='date',values='unblended_cost')
delta=(P[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-20')]-P[pd.Timestamp('2025-10-19')]).sort_values(ascending=False)
print('\nLargest positive changes:',delta.head(5).round(2).to_dict())
print('Largest negative changes:',delta.tail(5).round(2).to_dict())
print('\nDaily totals excluding QI:')
print(D[D.instance_family!='QI78eHTqNo'].groupby('date').unblended_cost.sum().round(2).to_string())
print('\nPrice changes from 19 to 20:')
a=D[D.date=='2025-10-19'].set_index('instance_family');b=D[D.date=='2025-10-20'].set_index('instance_family')
ch=b.price.sub(a.price); print(ch[ch.abs()>1e-9].sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())
print('\nNum_instances changes >=5 from 19 to 20:')
nch=b.num_instances-a.num_instances
print(nch[nch.abs()>=5].sort_values(ascending=False).to_string())
